title: EventBus callback self-duplicate registration recovery contract

contract.self_duplicate_registration_isolation: A callback can attempt to register itself again without aborting EventBus.emit()
contract.duplicate_registration_integrity: Self-registration does not create a duplicate listener entry
contract.current_cycle_delivery_once: The self-registering listener receives the active broadcast exactly once
contract.post_registration_delivery_once: Subsequent broadcasts continue delivering exactly once per registered listener
contract.registry_integrity: The listener registry remains structurally valid after callback-driven self-registration
contract.unique_owner_integrity: Self-duplicate registration does not create duplicate owner entries
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful before and after self-duplicate registration
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration and emit operations require the events permission
